about: Exact numbers from the drafter's scratch prototype (v2/tf2.py, which imports the engine of the study of parts that meet again read-only), registered with the pre-registration of TIME-AS-FOLD-20261125-001A. Each prediction's structural clause passes or fails on the new engine's runs. Limit: 600 seconds of process time for each run A and each test. Exact numbers are compared only over runs finished in both; counts of unfinished and undecided are not compared. Any disagreement is replayed birth by birth and reported. These numbers replicate the engine of the study of parts that meet again only. The prototype's own limits were 60 seconds of wall time for a census run and 600 seconds of wall time for all the tests of one run together, so the runs it counts as finished are those it finished within them. 'past' and 'nopast' are series taken with and without 'past its start'. A 'clock' is a series of returns of parts of two or more members with four consecutive equal periods. Weighting where a share is given: each start once up to isomorphism (A238) for the 227; each numbering once for the numberings; each run once otherwise.

paired.about: v2/k4_paired.py: every run of the main group, and of the 227 under MET, with a clock read without 'past its start'; per run each clock form once (size, periods, parity of the start round), its first j in (0, 1) with four equal periods, X at most 3; 600-second limit
paired.note: Verdict counts of version 2's summary; the verdicts under TD 4.6 of version 3 are in 'verdicts_td46'. Counts of undecided comparisons are not compared.

paired_numberings.about: v2/k9_numberings_cases.py: the fold study's four numberings for the STEPS-2 cases (not-all-equal only; the parity ones are in 'shifts of the order of distinctions'), and the first 150 of the two-knot case's numberings under OLDEST and not-all-equal at 18 rounds, stopped partway ('unfinished' rows reached the time limit; see 'two_knot_join_numberings')
paired_numberings.compared: only its rows of the STEPS-2 cases; its two-knot rows were cut short (the 600-second limit) and are not compared

convention_swap_partial.compared: no: the run was cut short by hand partway

two_knot_join_numberings.about: STEPS-2 for offshoots of joins, COPY-LAW(CANCEL-WAIT), two-knot start, every numbering, a 12-round search for a pass

verdicts_td46.about: Per law: tests, C failed/held, C-iii failed/held, recomputed from v2/k4_paired.jsonl under TD 4.6 of version 3 by v2/k12_verdicts_b2.py; no growth run. Undecided counts are listed and not compared.

registered_numberings_distinct.about: For each named start: the number of its 4n registered shifts and how many of them differ up to the start's own symmetries (give different named starts); for the two-knot start also its 240 numberings, which are 30 different named starts, each from 8 numberings. For the 227: [4n, distinct] per start.

shifts.about: the 4n shifts of the order of distinctions (TD 5.4) for the C-iii cases outside the two-knot start
